default.notes: Visit visa (VIVIS) required, applied for at a Brazilian embassy or consulate.

groups.notes: eVisa required since 10 April 2025 (about USD 80.90, applied for online). Stays up to 90 days per visit, max 180 days per year.

Visa-free under Mercosur/associate arrangements — nationals can enter with just their national ID card (no passport needed) and stay up to 90 days; extension possible via the Federal Police, total capped at 180 days per year.
Visa-free for tourism up to 90 days; the Federal Police can grant one extension, with total stays capped at 180 days per 12-month period.

BR.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Brazilian citizens.

VE.notes: Venezuelan citizens can enter visa-free, but with a shorter permitted stay of up to 60 days.

SG.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement, with stays limited to 30 days per visit.

KZ.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement for short stays (typically up to 30 days per visit) — confirm the current allowance with a Brazilian consulate.
